```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggalluvial)
library(highcharter)

library(networkD3)
```


```{r}

folder <- "<PROJECT_ROOT>/Manuscript_Figures/Figure_2/Data/"


rssc.genome <- read_tsv(paste0(folder, 'rssc.genome.tsv'),col_names = "strains") %>% pull(strains)

# tree file
rssc_tree <- ggtree::read.tree(file = paste0(folder, 'ufbootstrap_rssc.treefile')) 
  
# fastANI clusters and take only rssc genomes 
fastANI_clust <- read.csv(paste0(folder, 'test_member.csv'), header = F) %>% 
  filter(V1 %in% rssc.genome)

# fastbaps groups
fastbaps_clust <- read.csv(paste0(folder, 'RSSC-sensitive.fastbapsClusters.csv'))

# presence absence data
pa_mat <- read_tsv(paste0(folder, 'gene_presence_absence.Rtab'))


# twilight partition
twilight <- read_tsv(paste0(folder, 'twilight_classification.tab'))


fastbaps_clust <- read.csv(paste0(folder, 'RSSC-sensitive.fastbapsClusters.csv'))

fastbaps_l3 <- fastbaps_clust %>% 
  select(Isolates, Level.3) %>% 
  rename("strain" = Isolates , cluster = Level.3) %>% 
  # rownames_to_column(var = 'strain')  
  mutate(cluster = as.factor(cluster))

twilight <- twilight %>% 
  select(gene_name, specific_class) %>%
  rename("Gene" = "gene_name")

annot <- pa_mat %>% 
  pivot_longer(!Gene, names_to = "strain", values_to = "presence") %>% 
  left_join(., twilight, "Gene") %>% 
  # select(Gene, specific_class) %>% 
  filter(specific_class %in% twilight_class_order) %>% 
  select(Gene, specific_class) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  column_to_rownames("Gene")
  # select(strain, Gene, presence)


pa_with_twilight <- pa_mat %>% 
  pivot_longer(!Gene, names_to = "strain", values_to = "presence") %>% 
  left_join(., twilight, "Gene") %>% 
  filter(specific_class %in% c("Multi-lineage intermediate", 
                               "Lineage specific rare",
                               "Multi-lineage rare"))


pa_baps_tw <- pa_with_twilight %>% 
  left_join(fastbaps_l3, by = "strain") 
  # ggplot(., 
  #        aes(axis1= cluster, axis2 = specific_class)) +
  # scale_x_discrete(limits = c("cluster", "specific_class"),
  #                  expand = c(0.2, 0.05)) +
  # geom_alluvium(aes(fill = as.factor(presence)))
```

Use the network-D3
```{r}

links <- df_1000 %>% 
  group_by(cluster, presence, specific_class) %>% 
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(source = paste("Cluster", cluster),
         target = presence)





nodes <- data.frame(name= unique(c(links$source, links$target)))


links$source <- match(links$source, nodes$name) -1 

links$target <- match(links$target, nodes$name) - 1

links


sankeyNetwork(Links = links,
              Nodes = nodes,
              Target = "target",
              Value = "count",
              NodeID = "name")
```


```{r}
links %>% 
  select(source, target, count, specific_class) 
  ggplot(., 
         aes(axis1 = source, 
             axis2 = target,
             y = count,
             fill = specific_class)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = specific_class)) +
  geom_stratum() +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Cluster", "Presence"))
  
  
  
```
